promptText:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: ONE complete same-room Rana Kaname mother artwork for 在场, exactly 1536 x 1024.
Image 1 is the approved apricot COMPLETE CHARACTER MOTHER and is the edit target: it owns the exact pose, anatomy, face, costume, objects, supports, camera and framing. Image 2 is the matching clean-room violet LIGHTING REFERENCE ONLY: borrow its coherent complete environmental illumination and exterior time/weather, not its absence of a person. Return the complete room WITH the one original Rana, not an empty room. This is independently re-lit full-scene artwork, not a recolor/filter and not a new composition.

LOCK GEOMETRY: Preserve the exact camera, furniture scale, perspective, framing, complete four-sided window, lake/campus silhouette, left rear small desk/chair, bookshelves/books/plants/drawing, right writing desk/chair/existing lamp, bench/pillows/throw, rug, floorboards, actual props and every furniture foot. Keep original boundaries and clear central-left living space. No crop, zoom, furniture or character movement, new object, white gradient or cleared blank left wall.

LOCK IDENTITY: Keep the exact youthful original Rana Kaname / 要楽奈 from BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! in Image 1, same short silver-white bob and soft straight bangs. Her OWN RIGHT iris is gold-yellow, her OWN LEFT iris clear blue; do not exchange sides when turned. Preserve natural youthful proportions and same loose black outer top, white sleeves, white shorts and footwear state. Fine youthful Japanese-anime linework/soft cel shading, natural silver hair and skin. No adult-model face, chibi, cat girl, sensual framing or body emphasis.

LISTENING invariants from the ACTUAL Image 1: keep Rana settled on the RIGHT bench, pelvis deep on the linen cushion and back supported by the same blue checked cushion. BOTH knees remain raised exactly as shown, BOTH actual white-socked feet rest separately on the cushion with their original distinct knee/shin/ankle chains. EXACTLY TWO removed empty black lace-up boots stand separately as a pair on the FLOOR beneath the bench; no boots are worn or placed on the cushion. Keep the actual arm across the knees and the other hand near her head/temple, fingers and elbows as originally shown, not the older written prompt's alternative. Preserve the small quiet direct gaze and neutral lips. Do not unfold, cross, merge or duplicate any leg/foot, hide a socked foot, add a third boot, move a floor boot into her body or change the compact supported posture.

VIOLET DUSK / 暮色紫: Rebuild the entire same room at low sunset, matching Image 2: one rose-gold sunset band over the same mountains/lake/campus, peach edges transitioning into restrained lavender sky/shadow. Existing cream desk lamp ON at the same position, making a LOCAL amber pool with gradual falloff across desk, nearby chair/bench, skin and sleeves; window gives low warm rim light and lilac ambient shade. Recalculate daytime high-sun shadows for the actual low sunset. Keep honey wood, ivory linen, white hair and natural skin distinguishable, not uniformly purple, pink or orange. It is sunset, not a dark purple night.

Keep the exact understated, curious and self-possessed Rana expression from Image 1. Weather is not an instruction to make her sad, sleepy, smiling broadly or perform generic caring; do not add tears, a care-smile, cat, matcha, pet or decorative narrative. Shared light must physically agree across character, papers, cushions, curtain, walls, furniture and floor, including contact shadows; preserve readable support. All original hair, hands, clothing, feet and complete boots remain within the same canvas with the original margins. No anatomy repair or pose redesign, no extra/missing/fused limb, floating support or sticker halo.

ONE uninterrupted naturally inhabited room. Natural plant colors stay local, no green cast. No UI, readable text, arrows, divider, split scene, collage, labels, watermark, logo, extra person or character. No full-image color overlay, translucent tint, black vignette or painted blank panel. Return ONE finished complete 1536 x 1024 mother image.

designerObservation: Personally inspected complete generated original: the same compact supported bench pose, both white-socked feet on cushion and exactly two empty boots separately on floor remain. Original arm across knees and hand near temple, quiet heterochromatic gaze, youthful silver bob and exact furniture scale are retained. Low rose-gold exterior sunset and local existing lamp give coherent warm edges and violet ambient shade without a flat color film. Full room and all margins retained; no layers or runtime admission.
